description: Generation evaluation questions for the Harris County floodplain permit corpus. Each records how the question-answering pipeline should conclude, the facts a correct answer must state, and the documents it should cite. Facts are expressed as phrase requirements rather than as a reference answer, because a regulatory requirement has many correct wordings and scoring against one would punish a correct paraphrase. Expected facts and citation titles are provisional: they were written against the corpus structure and the fixture corpus in evaluation/fixtures/generation/, and must be re-verified against the ingested PDFs before a live baseline is read as a quality measurement. See docs/evaluation/evaluation-strategy.md.

questions.notes: The fixture answer for this question deliberately adds a fabricated dollar figure, so the committed baseline exercises unsupported-claim detection on a true positive. Two other fixture answers (gen-substantial-improvement, gen-manufactured-home) are flagged as false positives because they summarize the evidence in vocabulary the passages do not use; both are pinned in the baseline tests as a documented precision limit of the lexical screen.
